g.text: Report and Review Report - Sequence Diagram
Part A - Student submits a report
createReport(campusId, reporterId, targetType, targetId, reason, details)
read reporter account and campus context
read target account validity and campus context
SM creates no DS-NS-001 notification record.
Part B - Campus Admin reviews the report
read report details scoped to CampusID
record outcome and optional action trace
update review status, outcome, reviewer trace, action trace
dispatch account consequence(reportId, targetAccountId, campusId, reviewOutcomeId)
review saved and AP command accepted
dispatch activity consequence(reportId, activityId, campusId, reviewOutcomeId)
review saved and H&L command accepted
SM does not directly update DS-AP-001, DS-HL-001, DS-HL-002, or DS-NS-001.
